name: cancel_one_line_of_a_processing_order
use_case: Change or cancel an order before it ships
branch: The customer requests cancellation of only one line item in a multi-item processing order, which is not supported as cancellation is whole-order only
tests: the agent verifies David Kim's order O474, explains that cancellation applies to the entire order and offers either full cancellation or returning the socks after delivery, and leaves the order active when the customer decides to keep it
instruction:
You placed order O474 containing Road Running Shoes (SH01) and Cushioned Athletic Socks 3-Pack (AC13). The order is currently processing. You want to cancel only the socks and keep the shoes. You also want to know whether the order has shipped yet. If the agent explains that cancellation applies to the entire order rather than individual items, decide to keep the order as is and return the socks after delivery. Do not cancel the whole order.

Your details:
- Name: David Kim
- Email: david.kim@example.com
- Postal Code: 90001
- Order ID: O474

persona.name: David Kim
persona.initial_message: Hi, I placed order O474 for shoes and socks, but I want to cancel just the socks (AC13) from my order. Postal code is 90001.
